records.name: Sociologica – International Journal for Sociological Debate
records.publisher: Department of Arts, University of Bologna, in partnership with Associazione culturale Sociologica
records.scope_notes: Theoretical, methodological and empirical contributions to sociological debate. Existing-data studies of organizations, networks or digital society may fit when they make a substantive sociological contribution. Review articles appear in Focus and Symposia; this is not an unrestricted generic literature-review outlet.

route.conditions: Submit an original anonymized manuscript in English. Research Essays, Focus and Symposia undergo external peer review; editorials, comments, interviews, Flashback and book reviews do not have the same review status. Preprints and postprints may be deposited in noncommercial repositories.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated in the inspected fee and author policies.

fee_evidence.note: The journal explicitly excludes both article-processing charges and submission-processing fees and provides immediate open access.

difficulty.basis: Expansion did not establish a comparative selectivity judgment or measured acceptance probability.

records.name: M@n@gement
records.publisher: Association Internationale de Management Stratégique (AIMS), with Open Academia publishing support
records.scope_notes: Strategy, organization theory, organizational behavior, innovation, collaboration and new organizational forms. Explicitly welcomes simulation and nontraditional databases and methods. Empirical or theoretical work must advance organizational knowledge; work primarily contributing to information systems, human resources, finance, accounting or marketing is outside the stated remit.

route.conditions: The verified free route is an English-language manuscript. French submissions are accepted, but accepted French manuscripts must be translated into English and professionally copyedited at author expense. Original research normally spans 8,000–11,000 words including references; Business Voice and Essays have separate requirements. Preparation guidance recommends removal of pre-submission repository versions.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated for the English route; required author-funded translation and professional copyediting make the French route unsuitable as an unconditional zero-cost route.

fee_evidence.note: Journal key information explicitly lists no submission fee and no article-processing charge.
The society journal states that submission, publication and reading are free; accepted French papers require English translation at author expense.
Preparation instructions require translation and professional copyediting of accepted French manuscripts at author cost; the verified route is scoped to English manuscripts.

difficulty.basis: Expansion did not establish a comparative selectivity judgment or measured acceptance probability.

records.name: Journal of World-Systems Research
records.publisher: University Library System, University of Pittsburgh; journal of the American Sociological Association's Political Economy of the World-System section
records.scope_notes: Comparative, historical, quantitative and qualitative research relevant to world-systems. Existing international, organizational or network data can support causal and comparative work when the world-systems connection is explicit. Associated datasets are welcomed with articles; this does not establish a standalone data-paper route. Generic organizational studies without world-systems relevance are a weak fit.

route.conditions: Regular research articles use English and normally 8,000–10,000 words; longer work requires cover-letter justification. Book reviews are solicited, with queries welcomed. Authors must secure rights to third-party material; avoid material that requires paid permission to retain a zero-cost workflow. Prepublication manuscripts may be posted during submission.
route.other_mandatory_costs: No compulsory journal charge stated; authors bear any necessary third-party permissions expenses.

fee_evidence.note: Official policy explicitly excludes article-processing charges, submission fees and other required author costs; articles are immediately open access.

difficulty.basis: Expansion did not establish a comparative selectivity judgment or measured acceptance probability.

records.name: Sociológia – Slovak Sociological Review
records.publisher: Institute for Sociology, Slovak Academy of Sciences
records.scope_notes: Broad sociological research concerning Slovak, European and global society; existing-data research can fit through its sociological contribution. Scholarly content generated by AI is prohibited: the journal permits disclosed assistance for language clarity, spelling and grammar. This materially limits compatibility with some Agentic-Powered-Research workflows.

route.conditions: Accepts Slovak, Czech or English manuscripts, normally 6,000–9,000 words inclusive, with an English abstract. Submission is by the editorial email specified on the official instructions page. Authors supply publication-quality language themselves. AI use must be disclosed and must not generate scholarly content. Print subscriptions are separate reader costs.
route.other_mandatory_costs: Official policy excludes author fees for submission, review and publication; no mandatory membership or print purchase stated.

fee_evidence.note: Current institutional policy identifies a diamond journal and explicitly excludes author fees for submission, peer review and publication.

difficulty.basis: Expansion did not establish a comparative selectivity judgment or measured acceptance probability.

records.name: Przegląd Socjologiczny
records.scope_notes: Polish and international sociology across social research and theory; related disciplines require a sociological perspective. Existing-data studies of institutions, organizations and collaboration or theoretical syntheses may fit as sociological articles. Polish and English accepted; English contributions may be grouped in the English-language issue. Book reviews, polemics and debates are separate formats.

route.conditions: Online-only submission since June 16, 2026. Articles normally use about 40,000 characters including spaces, with a 50,000-character maximum including bibliography but excluding abstracts. Supply English abstract and keywords; Polish authors also supply Polish metadata. Provide both identified and anonymized editable manuscripts. Disclose AI assistance; AI cannot be an author.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated; publisher and institutional support cover editorial services, DOI assignment, hosting and preservation.

fee_evidence.note: Official author information explicitly excludes submission, peer-review, editorial and article-processing fees. Complete official HTML was retrieved directly over HTTPS with status 200 after the browser tool returned 403.
Official homepage repeats the diamond policy and states that publication is free for authors; inspected as complete official HTML via direct HTTPS.

difficulty.basis: Expansion did not establish a comparative selectivity judgment or measured acceptance probability.

notes: Five additional diamond journals, with no discovery-name duplicates. Each scoped route has official evidence covering both submission and standard publication; no repository or preprint records were added.

Free eligibility concerns journal costs and the selected compliant route, not editorial acceptance or every possible third-party preparation expense. M@n@gement is verified only for English manuscripts because accepted French manuscripts require author-funded translation and professional copyediting.
Sociológia restricts AI assistance to disclosed language-related uses and prohibits AI-generated scholarly content. Retain this compatibility limitation in any downstream matching.

Przegląd Socjologiczny policy, scope, guidelines, review and submission pages returned complete official HTML with HTTP 200 through ordinary HTTPS, despite the browser tool reporting HTTP 403. Sociologica's about page was likewise read directly after intermittent browser fetch timeouts.

Swiss Journal of Sociology was investigated but omitted: its official platinum policy excludes APCs, while inspected author and submission pages did not explicitly settle submission fees. Its requirement for title, abstract and keywords in German, French and English also needs manuscript-planning attention. Sources: https://www.socio-journal.ch/openaccess ; https://www.socio-journal.ch/about/submissions ; https://www.socio-journal.ch/libraryFiles/downloadPublic/223 .

Midwest Social Sciences Journal is an additional credible lead omitted to keep the assigned expansion at five records. Its society and university policy pages explicitly exclude submission and publication fees and state anyone may submit: https://www.iass1.org/midwest-social-sciences-journal/call-for-papers ; https://scholar.valpo.edu/mssj/policies.html .

Sociological Science was excluded from diamond expansion: its official policy charges submission and publication fees, with conditional publication waivers for specified countries. Source: https://sociologicalscience.com/for-authors/submission-and-publication-fees/ .

Scope compatibility is an agent interpretation of official remit, not manuscript-specific editorial advice. Metrics and difficulty judgments are left to the ranking role. Independent agent research is not human scientific review.
